snippet.title: Wavertree Mountain: Gameplay Trailer | Indie MMORPG on Steam
snippet.description:
Real gameplay from Wavertree Mountain, an indie MMORPG from a solo developer: fighting on the coast and in the forest, building a burrow from bare dirt, and life around the island's villages.

Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4725370/Wavertree_Mountain/

The humans are gone, and no creature alive knows why. Centuries later, six species have made the ruins of the old world their home, and two factions are fighting over what's left of it. Pick a side, dig a burrow of your own, and decide what kind of creature you want to be.

In this trailer:
- Rock crabs on the cliffs and beetles in the forest
- Building and furnishing a burrow, from bare dirt to a lamp-lit home
- Farms, a village square and a night camp by the fire

Features:
- Six playable species across two factions: the Warren Compact (Mouse, Squirrel, Chipmunk) and the Ashborne League (Rat, Lizard, Gerbil)
- Dig and furnish your own burrow, then tunnel out to your faction's outposts
- Claim outposts and hold them through PvP skirmishes and sieges
- Farm, fish, cook, craft and trade. You can play as a pacifist and still thrive
- Instanced dungeons in every zone and hundreds of missions
- Hundreds of players on each server

One purchase. No subscription. No pay-to-win.
Aiming to launch December 2026.

Follow along:
Website: https://www.wavertreemountain.com
Dev blog: https://www.wazzamouse.com/#devblog
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/wavertreemountain/
Discord: https://discord.gg/VCwFAwWeFv
X: https://x.com/wavertreemtn
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WavertreeMountain
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/wavertreemountain

#WavertreeMountain #IndieGame #MMORPG
